review_findings: Upgrade comparisons and terminal reserve/contribution charts are readable in the inspected phone, short-screen and desktop views.
The Ontario view includes Toronto/GTA, Ottawa and Windsor; historical marker coordinates were not shifted to resolve overlap.
The feature inspector distinguishes the diagonal sampled minimum, exact reference and proxy cost; channel/kernel effects remain separate from fire response.

Chromium accessibility trees expose named welcome/guide dialogs and fire pressure/crew/context; native keys, opener focus and normal-URL continuation pass at three sizes. Physical speech output remains untested.

At 1024/1280x600 the default instruments and command bar fit without scrolling; desktop advance is activated at initial scroll zero. Expanded instrument details can scroll. The pinned before-style clips the command bar; narrow portrait flow and game rules remain unchanged.

Adaptive instrument-matrix ink improves minimum measured contrast from 2.07 to 4.81 across 224 cells in 14 displays, with exact prior cell backgrounds, numbers, channel metrics and serialized saves. Zero-credit option descriptions remain visible while their labels/disabled states stay exact. This is scoped number/description readability, not whole-site accessibility certification.
scope: Fourteen bounded Chromium/authoring checks on this pinned build. Current-case summaries are published here; raw receipts/screenshots remain in ignored authoring cache. Native touch events are emulated; offscreen locators can auto-scroll except where the short-screen/upgrade case explicitly excludes it. Render/storage/audio failures and composition flags are injected fixtures. Saved Qiskit vectors are compared without new circuits. This is not physical-device, OS scheduling, assistive-technology, speaker listening, human enjoyment or full historical experiment certification.
runtime: Mac authoring browser with optional Codex-bundled Node/Playwright; owner viewer on 8790 stays running. These tools are not required for public viewing.
